thread.document:
Done as reflected on the deconflict sheet.

Note that I did Questions (1) and 5(c) on my other Special Participation B post, because I treated them as coding Questions. For this post, I do questions 2, 3, and 5(a)-(b).

I post the annotated chat below. Here is the link to the GPT chat: https://chatgpt.com/share/6938f111-c4b4-800d-90fd-000f7b0fa644

Question (2): ChatGPT solved this question without too much difficulty.

Question (3): ChatGPT actually encountered some difficulties on this question. First off, on 3(d)(ii), it did not read the figures correctly; I had to provide it with a screenshot of Figure 4 for the reasoning to work. Next, for 3(a), it provided me with a working primitive diagram, but also code for an Overleaf diagram. Despite several fixation attempts, the code never quiet worked, but it technically did "solve" 3(a) with the original diagram, which I attached below.

Question (5)(a)-(b): ChatGPT actually failed to solve this one at first, having "forgotten" Homework 12's full contents. I reattached the PDF and proceeded, and it worked.

Here was the 3(a) ASCII diagram and annotated chatlog PDF:
